notes.prevah: PREVAH ('simulation_based' in CAMELS-CH) is a calibrated process-based model whose calibration may have used the evaluation period. It is context only, NOT a fair out-of-sample competitor.

checks.description: files listed in SHA256SUMS match their SHA-256
results hold one daily frequency with a single time step at midnight dates
test dates in the run's config.yml equal periods.yml
basins in results equal basins_all.txt exactly
every date lies inside 2010-10-01..2020-09-30
no basin has duplicated dates
every basin has one row for every day of the period
simulations contain no NaN or infinite value
simulations are non-negative
observations in results equal raw 'discharge_spec(mm/d)' on the same dates (tolerance 0.0005 mm/d)
no observation present in the raw file is missing from the results
no basin has zero or near-zero (< 0.01 mm/d) flows in the FLV low-flow segment

details.note: FLV is unstable for these basins; prefer PBIAS and logNSE there

checks.description: own NSE agrees with the library's test_metrics.csv within 0.001
own KGE agrees with the library's test_metrics.csv within 0.001
own FHV agrees with the library's test_metrics.csv within 0.1
own FLV agrees with the library's test_metrics.csv within 0.1

details.note: Not a hard check. This script floors flows <= 0 at 1e-06 mm/d before the log and uses the exact Yilmaz et al. (2008) denominator; a different zero treatment or a small constant added to the denominator in the library changes FLV, most strongly for basins flagged in flv_low_segment.

checks.description: climatology and PREVAH benchmarks could be computed for every basin

details.climatology: mean observed discharge per calendar day over 1981-10-01 00:00:00..2005-09-30 00:00:00, raw column discharge_spec(mm/d)
details.prevah_note: PREVAH ('simulation_based' in CAMELS-CH) is a calibrated process-based model whose calibration may have used the evaluation period. It is context only, NOT a fair out-of-sample competitor.

checks.description: every basin in the results has a near_natural flag
no basin has NSE > 0.98
median NSE is not above 0.90
no simulation is identical to the observations
sim correlates better with obs shifted by one day than with same-day obs in at most 10 % of basins
